summary.result: The results showed a seasonal pattern, with weak stratification in winter, rapid development in spring, peak conditions in summer, and decay in autumn.
summary.background: Previous studies on estuarine reservoirs have mainly focused on salinity or temperature distributions, while integrated quantification of stratification based on an energy perspective remains limited.
summary.method: To address this gap, a coupled watershed-reservoir modeling framework was developed and applied to the Ganwol estuarine reservoir.
